title: An epic train chase is turning 100 — and Buster Keaton fans are celebrating
summary: 100 years ago, silent film star Buster Keaton filmed The General in Cottage Grove, Ore. Fans are gathering there to celebrate the making of an epic early film.
contentText:
The General, in Cottage Grove, Ore. Fans gathered in the town to celebrate the film's centennial with a conference, a look-alike contest, a 1920s costume party and tours of film locations.'/> 100 years ago, silent film star Buster Keaton filmed The General in Cottage Grove, Ore.
